strengths: Round 8 was taken almost whole, and the joins are seamless. 'So the file reopens, on a second question' gives Act 4 a spine. 'a hundred million monthly users within two months' makes the stampede literal. 'Some candles burned nearly forty years; some, two; one match, a day.' now matches the shelf. Turing's 'educate a child machine' plants the case's own question in 1950.

The spine holds over nearly 35 minutes: one case question, three suspects, a candle clock that turns 'how long people believed it' into a felt duration, and the quiet arc of the tall man, from 'far from the flame' through 'Thirty-six years at the edge of the light. Now, it found him.' to a phone call at two in the morning.

The plant-and-payoff web is the film's signature, and nearly every thread now closes by ear: 'Put that in the file' three times; 'If one exists.' → 'No straight cut can separate them.'; 'Who paid for dinner?' → 'Each man lost one bet.'; the clean bowl → 'Why choose the fog?'; 'Remember him.' → Widrow's 'never got over it'; 'a net that settles as it cools' → the Nobel citation; 'missed more than one in four' → 'Second place missed twenty-six point two'.

The deep dives teach by touch. The pierced tin stencil, 'Below zero counts as zero', the weir, 'They began as noise, like television snow', the two halves that split colour from edges 'Every time.' The transformer's three cards, 'two, nothing, four, two', the jug that 'pours softly' once divided by eight, 'Words talk to each other, then each thinks alone. Six times over.', and 'twice the words, four times the looking.' This is real mechanism, spoken.

The answer to the prologue is the best single beat in the film: 'Pick one. Ask again. No rulebook. Only odds.' It then pays off twice more: 'Not a new engine. A new door.' and 'Rosenblatt's 1961 note, sixty-one years on: language was the door.'

The wry, warm voice is consistent and earned. It saves its single first person for 'You could hear it learn. I love that.' Dry asides land ('A winter, then, of prestige, not of use.'; 'Its plan named no rival.'; 'It left out the research, and the chips.'; 'Two signed. The third stood apart.'). It is honest about uncertainty ('nobody knows exactly when'; 'Still argued.'; 'the accounts differ'; 'Its authors now call that result out of date.').

Fairness is dramatised rather than appended: the Navy, the press and Rosenblatt all 'fed the hype'; 'Fair credit: that was seven networks voting'; the Swiss lab; 'Google has acted very responsibly'; Beijing's reply in its own words; Anthropic's FTX money, book settlement and court fight under the same light as OpenAI's 'warning shot'.

The ending is earned. 'Never one person. The board was a network all along.' folds the thesis into the staging. The closing line turns the film's recurring dissenters at the rim into an invitation to the viewer: 'Somewhere tonight a lamp is on, and someone at the rim is suspicious. That is where new candles come from.'
